description: On a hillside neighbourhood in warm afternoon sun, hundreds of small brick and concrete houses, some painted green, yellow, blue and pink, are packed closely together up the steep slope, with flat roofs, water tanks, satellite dishes and tangled wires between them. In the foreground a young woman in a pink vest top, a patterned skirt and a headscarf walks up worn concrete steps between the houses, away from the viewer, carrying a basket of laundry on her hip, and gets smaller as she climbs.
